statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ has reversed sharply from the overnight high toward the session low, weakening the one-way Tail case while external Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold because meaningful two-sided retracement is visible, while the U.S. cash open remains the principal conditional structure checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail eases from upper WATCH as overnight advance reverses
body: Delayed NQ was 29,570.25 after opening at the 29,739.00 session high, with a 29,550.50 session low and 29,603.50 prior close. The roughly 169-point reversal from the high demonstrates meaningful retracement rather than persistent extreme-holding. Oil near multi-week highs and elevated Treasury yields keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hours are available. Tail ranged 17%-24% and Stress remained 100%; the published mode moved from event/whipsaw around the holiday session to mixed overnight, then trend-up at 06:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current two-sided retracement keeps Tail in WATCH despite extreme external Stress. The principal conditional danger window is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open; elevated Tail requires unrepaired extreme-holding, shallow or failed pullbacks, and renewed extension.

forecast.analysis: If European trade stays two-sided, Tail would ease within WATCH. A low retest without repair would preserve risk; known energy stress remains a volatility input.
WATCH remains conditional on the overnight-low response. Repair would weaken Tail; a clean break followed by shallow rebounds would strengthen the adverse path.
Low Tail assumes overlapping European trade. A directional break that refuses retracement would invalidate the easing case and restore WATCH.
Late-European repair keeps Tail low in the base case. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would reverse that assessment despite the prior retracement.
U.S. premarket participation raises whipsaw sensitivity. Directional expansion with weak retracements would lift Tail; balanced trade would keep it in WATCH.
The first post-holiday cash open sits in this hour. Elevated Tail requires an unrepaired opening impulse, extreme-holding and shallow or failed pullbacks.
